'''Fenrij''' was a member of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. Fenrij took part in an operation to kidnap [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Janissa Locrin]], following [[Seland' Ir]]'s scheme.
